sources.title: smolvla_base: Image-to-Video model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview SmolVLA is a compact vision-language-action model with 450M parameters designed for robot manipulation tasks, built and maintained by lerobot. The model accepts multi-view images, proprioceptive state, and optional language instructions as inputs and outputs continuous robot actions. It trains using flow matching as the training objective and represents actions in continuous space ...
